_help: Modifier tree (scripts/ModTree.cs, menu U). Each branch is a lane of modifiers in order: a modifier can only be unlocked once the one before it in its lane is unlocked (the first one is free to reach). 'supports' are skill modifiers (data/skills.json supports; every one fits every skill), 'attackMods' are basic attack modifiers (data/attacks.json mods). A support missing from every lane joins the first lane whose 'tags' it shares, or the last lane. To add a modifier: add it to skills.json or attacks.json and (optionally) list it here where it belongs in the lane.

branches.name: Area
branches.desc: Bigger, denser, longer or heavier blasts.

branches.name: Projectiles
branches.desc: Faster, more, seeking, piercing and chaining shots.

branches.name: Elements
branches.desc: Burn, chill, shock and poison on hit, or turn the damage into an element.

branches.name: Wounds
branches.desc: Bleed, sunder, judge, weaken and root; true damage.

branches.name: Precision
branches.desc: Critical strikes and finishing the weak.

branches.name: Sustain
branches.desc: Drain life, heal on use and get your mana back.

branches.name: Arcane Triggers
branches.desc: Skills that repeat or cast themselves.

branches.name: Weapon Arts
branches.desc: Modifiers for your basic attack chains (menu O).
